instrument.title: Prescribing the Emergency Provisional Fare Matrix for Tricycle-for-Hire Amid COVID-19 Pandemic, Thereby Suspending the Implementation of City Ordinance No. 2009-17, 'An Ordinance Amending the Existing Fare Matrix on All Tricycles for Hire Plying Within the City of Cabadbaran, Agusan del Norte, as Fixed by City Ordinance No. 2009-01', Until the Situation Returns to Normal as Officially Declared by Authorities

lgus.spReviewNote: Special City Ordinance No. 2020-012 was declared valid by Resolution 2020-res-402. The later City Ordinance No. 2026-011 was declared invalid as ultra vires by Resolution 432-2026 on 2026-10-06. The city BPLO therefore supplies only the 2020 ordinance as the legal basis and issues the current fare matrix administratively.
lgus.rateSummary: 66 posted rows, ₱9.00 to ₱70.00 flat by route; no per-kilometre add-on and no discount column.
gaps: The MINIMUM RATE P10.00 callout is P1.00 above the P9.00 row on the same posting and has no stated basis.
The board matrix names no enabling ordinance, so its legal basis is asserted by BPLO rather than printed.
No text of City Ordinance No. 2026-011 was obtained; the P13.00/P11.00 attribution to it is inference, not evidence.
SCO 2020-012 Section 4's sunset condition has arguably operated nationwide, which would revive City Ordinance No. 2009-17. No Cabadbaran-specific normalcy declaration was located either way.
The 2009-17 matrix amounts are not published, so the literal fallback cannot be quoted.
The 17 July 2026 posting has no discount column at all, so the student/senior/PWD amount rests on the statutes rather than on the posting.

sunsetClause.text: This Ordinance shall be automatically repealed and/or revoked once the situation returns to normal as declared by authorities with finality. Declaration from the Department of Health and from the IATF, placing the City of Cabadbaran out of any kind or form of community quarantine and free from COVID-19 infection and contamination, thereby lifting the rules and regulations on social-physical distancing and other related issuances. Upon such declaration, City Ordinance No. 2009-17 shall be automatically restored and implemented.
sunsetClause.effect: The ordinance is self-terminating. It is the instrument the city BPLO continues to cite, but its own sunset provision ties its life to a COVID-19 normalcy declaration that has since occurred nationally. Read literally, Section 4 has already revived City Ordinance No. 2009-17.

intercity.explanation: Butuan is the province's transport hub: its Langihan complex holds the jeepney terminal, the New Integrated Van Terminal and the City Integrated Bus Terminal. Every other LGU in the province is reached from it, so the layer is hub-and-spoke.
intercity.distanceSource: OSRM / OpenStreetMap driving route, poblacion-to-poblacion fastest path, queried 2026-10-28. Coordinates are the Wikipedia/Wikidata town-centre points recorded in ml/data/adn_poblacion_points.json.
intercity.method: Add-on method. Fares are rounded to the nearest 25 centavos. Where a guide gives a base fare and base distance, the base covers the first N km and each succeeding kilometre adds the per-km rate. Where a guide gives only a per-km rate, the whole distance is multiplied by that rate.
intercity.temporaryGuideNote: The matrices downloaded on 2026-09-28 are temporary guides. Operators may display them only until 2026-12-31 and must display the official guide from 2027-01-01. The fare amounts do not lapse on 2026-12-31; they stand until LTFRB replaces them, so this is a display deadline, not an expiry.
intercity.caveat: These are authorized maxima. A driver who collects more is overcharging; a driver who collects less is discounting.

discount.note: 20% off the regular fare every day, including weekends and holidays.

intercity.classificationPrinciple: LTFRB sets fares by service class, not by body style. A multicab with a PUJ franchise collects the PUJ fare; a van with a UV Express franchise collects the UV Express rate; a mini bus collects whichever class its franchise names. Assigning a fare from the body alone is the error this section exists to prevent.

bodyStyleNotes.note: A mini bus is priced by its franchise: UV Express if that is the franchise, provincial bus if it is a PUB.
